name: XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS_
description: This is the audit table for XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS which stores the header information for a control budget.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction

columns.name: CREATED_FROM_CODE
columns.description: Method used to create this control budget. Valid values are CB_UI and PPM_API.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Control budget name user identifier

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the control budget

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Budget calendar period set name

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Control budget calendar period type

columns.name: START_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Start period of the control budget

columns.name: END_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: End period of the control budget

columns.name: START_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the start period of the control budget

columns.name: END_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the end period of the control budget

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the start period of the control budget. Together with the end date, they indicate the entire date ranges of the control budget

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the end period of the control budget. Together with the start date, they indicate the entire date ranges of the control budget

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET_SYSTEM_CODE
columns.description: The source budget type code where budgets were created

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: XCC lookup code or control budget name value. Dependant on the source budget type code value

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Control level code that will be used when determining funds available for distributions that fall into this supplimental budgetary control or default rule

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: The % of the budget amount that will be used as tolerance

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The fixed amount that will be used as tolerance

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency assigned to the control budget

columns.name: DEFAULT_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Default rate type assigned to the control budget

columns.name: BUDGET_MANAGER_ID
columns.description: Budget manager responsible for this control budget

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code of the control budget

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledgers defined in GL and enabled for budgetary control. Default value is -98.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield structure defining column for the associated ledger's chart of accounts

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Project accounting project unique identifier. Default value is -98.

columns.name: BUDGET_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield structure defining column for the control budget accounts

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CREATION_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that when control budget accounts do not exist, they will be created by the system

columns.name: BALANCE_INCREASES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether increases are allowed as adjustments to the initial loaded amounts for control budget combination for this control budget or not

columns.name: BALANCE_DECREASES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether decreases are allowed as adjustments to the initial loaded amounts for control budget combination for this control budget or not

columns.name: NEGATIVE_BALANCES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether funds available balance is allowed to go negative from the  adjustment to the initial loaded amounts for control budget combination for this control budget or not

columns.name: BDG_AMT_NOT_FOUND_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Result when budgeted amount not found. In V2, this column will be defaulted to PASS and won't be exposed in the UI. In future releases, it will have values as FAIL or PASS

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: UOM assigned to the control budget

columns.name: RULE_SQL
columns.description: Rule SQL statement generated by the compiler

columns.name: PARENT_SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: Source budget type code of the master control budget

columns.name: PARENT_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source budget name of the master control budget

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Contains the previous status of the control budget. This is used when the status needs to be reverted to the previous status.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERRIDES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if overrides are allowed for this control budget.

columns.name: NO_OVERRIDES_NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the budget owner must be notified when no overrides are available.

columns.name: OVERRIDES_TAKEN_NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the budget owner must be notified when a override is taken.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum override amount allowed for this control budget. Amount is in the budget currency.

columns.name: RECALC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the recalculation program.

columns.name: PCBD_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code indicating the error that was first encountered by the Prepare Control Budget Definition program.

columns.name: IN_USE_END_EFF_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: End period effective number of the control budget when it was In Use the last time.

columns.name: RECALC_SUCCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the recalculation program has run successfully for this control budget.

columns.name: PCBD_INCOMPATIBLE_DATA
columns.description: Stores the parameter value, such as a control budget identifier. This prevents the prepare control budget definition process from running in parallel with another process that has the same value in this column.

columns.name: CUBE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to XCC_BALANCES_CUBES. A null value means that either the cube does not exist, or the cube exists but control budget is not part of it yet.

columns.name: REFRESH_BALANCES_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that balances for this control budget must be refreshed into the corresponding cube.

columns.name: FUNDS_RELEASE_TIMEFRAME
columns.description: Determines when the funds are made available for a particular period. Valid values are: RELEASE_IMMEDIATELY and RELEASE_UPON_OPEN.

columns.name: PJC_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: Project accounting contract unique identifier for the award associated with the budget amount. Default value is -98.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BUDGET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Order of segments in the budget chart of accounts structure. For example, PARF indicates a segment order of Project, Award, Top Resource, Funding Source.

columns.name: FV_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the budgetary control processing type of the control budget.

columns.name: OFFLINE_REASON_CODE

columns.name: ALLOW_REVENUE_FUNDING_FLAG
